title: VXAce Needed to make this falling animation for a cutscene but this happens.

posts.author: DeadManDan98
posts.body: I had asked reddit for help before, and I fixed it. But the problem is that I forgot how to fix it.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
that picture is not in the format expected for a sprite.
sprites have 3x4 cells, or 12x8 cells for a spritesheet.
no other format can be used in the editor.
your's has 1x5 cells visible, or 2x6 cells if counting transparent areas.

posts.body:
DeadManDan98 said:

Click to expand...
no
a sprite has 3x4 cells only . four direction frames vertical and three animation frames horizontally.
the sprite above needs to be split into at minimum two different sprites to be usable at all, depending on how you want that to happen.
make a door quick event, save it and then edit it to see one possible way to handle animations.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
DeadManDan98 said:
I have GIMP program. And I have RPG Maker Ace VX
Click to expand...
that has nothing to do with what I wrote.
it doesn't matter which image program you use, you have to follow the formats allowed by the engine or whatever changes you make in the script editor.
In my answer above I was telling you to use the second option/example listed above, the one with the 3x4 coffins. And since you can have a maximum of four animation frames controllable in that structure you'll have to split your eight frames into two different sprites of that format.
